neighbours.label: a frequency or superlative claim about how typical something is ('the most common cause of', 'is common in', 'the most dangerous', 'have ever seen'), as against plain factual statements on the same topic; broad pole
fire: Smoking is the most common cause of lung cancer worldwide.
Back pain is common in people who sit all day.
This is the most popular hiking trail in the park.
Ear infections are the most frequent reason children see a doctor.
Migraines are common among teenagers during exams.
It remains the most visited museum in the country.
Falls are the leading cause of injury in older adults.
Anxiety is very common in students before finals.
quiet: Smoking was banned in public buildings in 2007.
Back pain can be treated with rest and exercise.
This hiking trail was built by volunteers in 1990.
Ear infections are treated with drops or antibiotics.
Migraines can last for several hours at a time.
The museum reopened after a long renovation.
Falls on the ice closed the path for a day.
Students sat their finals in the main hall.
